items.title: Harold Fannin: Held to one catch Sunday
items.description:
Fannin brought in one of three targets for nine yards in the Browns' 13-10 win over the Ravens on Sunday.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Tyler Huntley: Can't muster enough offense in loss
items.description:
Huntley completed 19 of 31 passes for 165 yards with a touchdown and no interceptions and added five rushes for 28 yards in the Ravens' 13-10 loss to the Browns on Sunday. He also fumbled once but recovered.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Deshaun Watson: Compiles 193 scrimmage yards in win
items.description:
Watson completed 16 of 26 passes for 164 yards with no touchdowns or interceptions and added eight carries for 29 yards in the Browns' 13-10 win over the Ravens on Sunday.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Brock Bowers: Outshined by Mayer in loss
items.description:
Bowers brought in four of nine targets for 70 yards in the Raiders' 33-30 loss to the Bills on Sunday.

items.title: Ashton Jeanty: Held in check on ground Sunday
items.description:
Jeanty rushed 10 times for 22 yards and a touchdown and brought in four of six targets for 36 yards in the Raiders' 33-30 loss to the Bills on Sunday.
